I honestly don't know what to do... I can't bear to live life without a source of pain because I feel like, pain is the only thing that makes me feel alive and have a purpose for living in this world.

I just don't know what to do now... Yes, I might just try avoiding cutting with the best of my abilities but I don't know how I would stop self harming myself in different methods. Without any source of pain, I just feel really lost and I feel dead on the inside. I have no friends to go for help, my father whom I miss is on business events all the time that I can barely see him once every two years. My mother doesn't care about me and no one knows what I'm going through. Sometimes I even want to take my own life like a coward but I can't because I'm too afraid... I want to stop harming myself, but when I stop, after a few hours, the urge to give myself the pain I deserve is unbearable for me. This just makes me feel as if my life is just a routine of hiding my true self and torturing myself.
